start_here: No signup, no API key, and NO WALLET needed to start. GET /v1/search/{q} (address -> PIN) and GET /v1/sample are always free, and the first 25 calls per client per day to /v1/parcel, /v1/dossier and /v1/comps return REAL data with no payment. The prices below therefore apply only PAST that daily allowance, which resets at 00:00 UTC.

/v1/search/{q}.summary: Address → PIN lookup for Cook County / Chicago.

/v1/parcel/{pin}.summary: Single Cook County, IL parcel record by PIN: street address, city, ZIP, assessor property class, township, neighborhood, ward/municipality,…

/v1/dossier/{pin}.summary: Complete Cook County / Chicago property record in one call: parcel basics PLUS recorded sales & deed history, building permits, and…

/v1/comps/{pin}.summary: Comparable sales (comps) and a lightweight automated valuation for a Cook County / Chicago property: recent arm's-length sales in the same…

daily_allowance.metering: per client, resets daily at 00:00 UTC
daily_allowance.note: Just call the paid routes — the first 25 calls a day return real data with no payment. After that they return the normal 402 and x402 payment settles the rest. Response headers X-Free-Tier-Remaining / X-Free-Tier tell you where you stand.

terms.license: Underlying records are Cook County / City of Chicago public open data. Responses may be stored, cached and redistributed by the caller; attribution to the Cook County Assessor/Recorder and City of Chicago open data is requested, not required.
terms.warranty: Provided as-is from public records. No warranty of accuracy, completeness or fitness for a particular purpose. Not affiliated with or endorsed by any government body. Not an appraisal, title report, or legal advice.
terms.sla: Best-effort, single region. No uptime guarantee. Liveness: GET /healthz. Data refreshed nightly; every answer carries as_of.
terms.privacy: Property-keyed only. No owner, buyer, seller or occupant names are stored on any serving path or logged.

price_promise: Prices are fixed; any change is announced in https://api.ingest0r.com/changelog.json at least 30 days ahead and never applies retroactively.
comparison: Typical commercial property-data APIs charge $0.10–$0.25+ per lookup with signup and API keys; every route here is at or below $0.10 with neither.
